papers.summary_en: We describe the integration of io_uring into Oracle Database's storage layer and the architectural decisions required to deploy it in a production multi-process RDBMS. Our design uses per-process ring contexts that eliminate inter-process synchronization, a shared buffer registration mechanism now part of the mainline Linux kernel, and a transparent fallback to libaio on error.
